description: The `key` of /v1/apps/{project}/r2/{bucket}/objects/{key} spans path segments. The spec says so on the parameter ("May contain `/`, which must stay literal in the path. Percent-encoded dots, slashes and backslashes are refused.") and marks it `allowReserved: true`, which the converter does not read. As a plain label, `assets/logo.png` would be sent as `assets%2Flogo.png`, which Sproutboat refuses. Make it a greedy `{key+}` label on getR2Object, putR2Object and deleteR2Object, so each `/` stays literal and every segment is still percent-encoded.
